entities.name: Yuri Gagarin Cosmonaut Training Center
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Yuri A. Gagarin State Scientific Research and Testing Cosmonaut Training Center is a Russian facility that trains cosmonauts for their space missions. It is in Star City of Moscow Oblast, a name which may refer to the facility itself or to its grounds.
